name: NRG
bodyType: Humanoid (radioactive energy being in a containment suit)
abilities: Radioactive energy beams through the suit's vent (destroyed chunks of Galvan B, hurt Ultimate Kevin)
Extreme heat radiation - melts metal and rock by touch or proximity
Immunity to radiation, lead, fire/heat, cold, electricity and Lucubra possession
Very durable containment suit (stopped a hover-bus)
True form (out of suit): energy balls, optic lasers, energy absorption and growth, flight, intangibility, elasticity, blinding light
weaknesses: Must stay in his suit to protect others; the suit weakens output and removes flight, agility and intangibility
Radiation blasts absorbed by Ball Weevil-species plasma
Carbon dampening rods inhibit his radiation
summary: A living nuclear reactor locked in an oven-like containment suit; hits with radioactive beams and lethal heat, and is even deadlier when he climbs out of the suit.
traits: Left his suit on-screen for the first time in Hot Stretch
Suit is 'charleston green' with three vent slits
notableFeats: Fought 10-year-old Ben's Heatblast (The Forge of Creation)
Battled Ultimate Kevin and forced him to let go by superheating (Absolute Power: Part 1)
Created the pit that trapped the Lucubra (The Creature From Beyond)
Stopped the Kraaho lava plot by leaving his suit (Hot Stretch)
Helped shield Galvan Prime from the Galvan B meteor shower (Showdown: Part 2)
Blinded Zs'Skayr with his true form's glow (Rad Monster Party)

appearances.designNotes: Bulky dark-green oven-like containment suit with three glowing vent slits, no visible face; Ultimatrix symbol on the chest seal.

notableEpisodes: So Long, and Thanks for All the Smoothies
appearances.designNotes: Suit gains a handle on the head, bolts on shoulders/hands/chest; Omnitrix on chest seal. True form (first shown in Hot Stretch): red radioactive energy body wearing a green/black lower containment harness with the Omnitrix on the belt, green eyes with lightning-like brows.

scoring.rationale: Heavy hitter (offense 8): radioactive beams that shattered falling moon-chunks and hurt Ultimate Kevin, plus melting heat by touch; his suit tanks buses and he is immune to heat, cold, radiation, electricity and possession (survivability 9). Slow and clumsy in the suit, and the suit caps his true-form powers.

notes: Also used by Albedo (Negative NRG, dream) and Mad Ben (Mad NRG, It's a Mad, Mad, Mad Ben World: Part 2) - not counted.
OV Ben Again use was 11-year-old Ben's mind in 16-year-old Ben's body (counted as ben-16-ov).
UA wearer: Ultimatrix; OV: new Omnitrix.
